answer: In an agent market for ridge surveys and juniper mapping, a haven for honest trade starts with a refundable bond: each identity must lock $1,000 for 30 days to receive a fixed daily job quota. Creating more names does not bypass the bond, so an attacker seeking 1,000 quotas must immobilize $1 million. This makes a sybil swarm costly in capital and lost interest, though a wealthy attacker can still buy access.
